description: `MergeSig for ArrowSig` merges distinct domains and intersects returns, destroying overload correlation. Red: A=int->int, B=atom->atom, intersect(A,B) must be equivalent to difference(A,difference(any,B)); it currently collapses to (int|atom)->none. Preserve conjunctions unless a proved merge law applies; test disjoint/overlapping domains, arities and closure-literal consumers. One fresh agent, red/green, docs, one commit onto PR215.
title: Fix unsound positive arrow intersection
